sections.content: A subquery is a SELECT inside another query — in WHERE (filter by computed value), FROM (treat results as a table), or SELECT (computed column).
Correlated subqueries reference the outer row and run per-row — powerful but slow on big tables; prefer JOINs when possible.
Key points: subqueries must return one column in WHERE comparisons, IN/EXISTS/ANY are the common patterns, and CTEs (WITH) often read cleaner.

sections.codeExample:
SELECT name FROM users
WHERE age > (SELECT AVG(age) FROM users);
